name: Jingle Balls

features.name: Reel-specific mechanics
features.description: xWays, xNudge and xSplit each own a pair of reels.

features.name: xSplit Wilds
features.description: Split the symbols on their reel.

features.name: Spirit Spins
features.description: The mechanic placements swap in the bonus.

review:
Jingle Balls is a twisted Christmas slot on a 3-3-4-4-5-5 grid. xWays lands on reels 1 and 2 in the base game, xNudge Wilds on reels 3 and 4, and xSplit Wilds on reels 5 and 6. In the Spirit Spins bonus, the xWays and xSplit placements swap sides.

Every mechanic has its own reels, which makes the game easier to follow than most xMechanics games. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 12,250x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
